summary: Element-wise subtract of two 16-byte geometry records: writes a2 - a3 into this as float(0), double(4) and float(12), then returns the a2 pointer. Called by RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision (0x0044AAE0) for collision triangle edge subdivision.

operations.description: Write output float at this+0 = a2.float(0) - a3.float(0).
Write output double at this+4 = a2.double(4) - a3.double(4).
Write output float at this+12 (float index 3) = a2.float(12) - a3.float(12).
Return the a2 input pointer as the result value.

unresolved: Layout float(0), double(4), float(12) is not a plain Vec3; Vec3Subtract is the legacy ABI name and does not fully describe the record.
The meaning of the double component at offset 4 within the triangle-edge record is unknown.
